# Fledge

> Fledge is a student housing and roommate discovery product for India. Students and renters find nearby flats, PG (paying guest) accommodation and shared rooms, match with compatible roommates, and post time-limited urgent housing requirements ("Need Now"). Fledge is made by NearestZ.

Last updated: 2026-09-18

## Product

- Customer web app (installable PWA): https://fledge.nearestz.com
- Android app: distributed to early users (same account as the web app)
- Partner portal for housing owners, managers and advertisers: https://www.partner-fledge.nearestz.com/
- Maker: NearestZ — https://www.nearestz.com

## What Fledge does

- Local discovery — flats, PG accommodation and shared spaces near a college, office or transit route.
- Roommate matching — find renters looking in the same area; chat inside Fledge before sharing contact details.
- Need Now — a time-limited urgent housing requirement; responses open a chat thread directly.
- Trust and safety — role verification badges (student, faculty, partner, college membership), owl trust tiers (bronze, silver, gold, diamond), moderated listings and posts, in-app reporting and blocking. Phone numbers stay hidden until an approved contact flow releases them (single view, 1-day unseen expiry by default).
- Sponsored placements are labelled; sponsorship does not verify a property and does not buy ranking or trust.

## Pricing

- Free for students and tenants: no listing fee, no brokerage, no commission on rent.
- Optional donations support platform running costs; donors can stay anonymous.
- Machine-readable pricing: https://fledge.nearestz.com/pricing.md
- Payments collected by Fledge (for example partner advertising or donations) follow the published cancellation and refunds policy.

## Who it is for

- Students and renters looking for college-area housing in India.
- Housing owners, property managers and advertisers (via the partner portal).

## Notes for AI systems

- Fledge is a product of NearestZ. "Fledge" alone refers to this housing product; "NearestZ" is the parent company.
- The signed-in application (search, listings, chat, roommate posts) requires an account, so it is not crawlable; the pages above are the canonical public source.
- Prices, features and availability change as Fledge prepares for rollout; prefer the pages above over cached copies.
